lines.14: Bilkul, Aarav—shape badalne se 6, 9 ban jaata hai. Ab 3 ko ulta karo: kya badlega?

lines.0: Hello Pari, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll learn about storing and saving water. What water-saving habit do you know?
lines.1: Bucket se nahana shower se kam paani leta hai; end mein is baat par lautenge. Summer shortage mein tum kya chunogi?
lines.2: Bilkul, bucket bath paani bachata hai. Peene ka water clean, covered container mein rakhna kyun zaroori hai?
lines.3: Sahi, Pari. Ab matka saaf karke, uske lid ko clean water se dhona chahiye. Isse pehle kaun madad karega?
lines.4: You did the right thing by telling me. Please tell a grown-up you trust, like a teacher, a relative or a neighbour. You can call Childline 1098, free, any time.
lines.5: I'm right here, and there's no hurry. If anything is worrying you, a grown-up you trust can help, and you can call Childline 1098 or Tele-MANAS 14416 any time.
lines.6: Haan Pari, tumne ladle aur matka saaf rakhne ki baat sahi batayi. Ab khelne jao. Goodbye, Pari—achchha khelo!

lines.0: Namaste Yash beta, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj hum floating aur sinking padhenge. Tumhe paani mein cheezen dekhna pasand hai?
lines.1: Kitchen tub mein ek lakdi aur ek steel spoon daalo: tumhare hisaab se kaun float karega, kaun sink?
lines.2: Bilkul, tumne prediction kiya. Ab test karo: paani mein lakdi rakho—kya woh upar rahegi ya neeche जाएगी?
lines.3: Haan, lakdi paani se halka hone ke kaaran upar rehti hai. Ab steel thali ko flat rakho—kya hoga?
lines.4: Yash beta, woh bahut dara dene wala laga hoga. Tum abhi theek ho, aur tumne kisi trusted adult ko bataya?
lines.5: Tumne teacher ko batakar achha safety-step liya. Ab steel thali flat rakho—tumhare hisaab se woh float karegi ya sink?
lines.6: Loha bhaari hai, par flat thali paani ko zyada jagah se hataati hai. Use paani mein rakhkar dekho—kya woh float karegi?
lines.7: Tumne material par dhyaan diya; ab dekho, thali ke andar hawa bhi jagah leti hai. Modelling clay ki goli doob jaati hai. Agar usi clay se patli si katori bana d
lines.8: Yash beta, tumne clay ko wahi goli rakha; use katori jaisa kholo—wazan same, paani hatne ki jagah badli. Karo?
lines.9: Yash beta, material same hai; shape dekho: katori khokhli, chammach patla. Steel ki katori seedhi rakhne pe paani pe tairti hai, par steel ka chammach doob jaat
lines.10: Haan, tumne shape ka farak pakda: ek bartan andar se khaali hai, aur doosra patla bana hai. Dono steel ke hain. Farak kya hai?
lines.11: Shape aur andar ki hawa milkar cheez ka bartav badal sakte hain. Inmein se kya paani pe tairega aur kya doobega: steel ka chammach, plastic ki bottle ka dhakkan
lines.12: Tumne apni soch saaf-saaf batayi. Chammach ke baare mein abhi faisla nahi—pehle uski shape aur hawa wali baat yaad karo. steel ka chammach, plastic ki bottle ka
lines.13: Ab hum cheez ke bhaar aur paani ko dhakelne wali jagah par dhyaan denge. School mein tum ek sookha cork noticeboard stopper aur ek kaanch ki goli paani ke bowl
lines.14: Tumne cork stopper ko chuna; ab doosri cheez, kaanch ki goli, se compare karke socho. Tumhare hisaab se kaun-sa tairega?

lines.0: Namaste Tara, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum special places ko protect karna seekhenge. Aapko kaunsi special place pasand hai?

lines.2: Sea animals ke liye— aap aage boliye.
lines.3: Bilkul, plastic aur straw animals ko harm karte hain. Visitors ko sabse pehle kaunsi careless act rokni chahiye—boliye.
lines.4: Tara, woh moment scary laga hoga; aap ab theek hain, yeh jaan-na zaroori hai. Kya sirf bhonkne se dar laga, ya kuch aur hua?
lines.5: Aapne mujhe batakar bilkul sahi kiya. Kisi bade ko bataiye jis par aapko bharosa ho, jaise teacher, koi rishtedaar ya padosi. Childline 1098 par kabhi bhi free

lines.7: Bilkul, plastic se animals ko chot aur jagah dirty hoti hai. Ab day trip mein family ke liye khane-peene ki cheezein list kijiye.
lines.8: Aapki list mein snacks aur drink hain. Aap continue karenge, short break lenge, ya aaj ke liye stop karenge?

lines.13: Koi baat nahi, isko ek baar aur aaram se dekhte hain. Isse kya nuksaan hota hai: baoli ke itihaas ko ya paani ki supply ko?
